parent_generation.rejection_reason: Foreground heroine occupied roughly one third of frame height, weakening the tower-dominant scale relationship.

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: visual-novel CG R0 layout correction
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and the entire accepted layout foundation.
Primary request: Change only the foreground heroine's scale. Reduce the same back-facing heroine to approximately ONE THIRD of her current pixel height, so she is a tiny witness under 12 percent of the full frame height. Keep her feet anchored on the same lower-left quay area and keep her looking at the tower. Reconstruct the wet quay naturally where her former larger silhouette was.
Invariants: Keep the canvas 16:9. Keep the tower, sealed gate, exactly seven vertical blue-violet facade lights, beacon, single far-left evacuation ship, sea, storm front, architecture, camera, horizon, lighting, palette and all other geometry unchanged. Keep exactly one heroine and exactly one ship. Preserve her back-facing long midnight-blue hair, navy-and-ivory mantle silhouette and adult proportions at the smaller scale.
Constraints: edit only heroine scale and the immediately exposed background; no new characters, no new ships, no text, no logo, no watermark.
